target.title: [Bug]: Openclaw workboard ui is not optimised for multiple cards
target.body: ### Bug type Behavior bug (incorrect output/state without crash) ### Beta release blocker No ### Summary The workboard ui in web console doesnt handle the multiple cards well. The cards merge into each and shrink if they run out of vertical space. Also the actions that are present in the card summary card on board like delete, change status, play, edit, archive are not available in the expanded ui of the card. ### Steps to reproduce 1. Create multiple workboard cards(atleast 15) in a workboard. Make sure they all have same status. 2. Open workbaord in openclaw web ui. 3. Observe the cards ui in the collapsed state on the board. ### Expected behavior The ui should be scalable and scrollable. The actions on the summarised card should also be present in the expanded card. ### Actual behavior The workboard ui in web console doesnt handle the multiple cards well. The cards merge into each and shrink if they run out of vertical space. Also the actions that are present in the card summary card on board like delete, change status, play, edit, archive are not available in the expanded ui of the card. ### OpenClaw version 2026.6.11 ### Operating system macOS 26.5 ### Install method pnpm gateway:launch ### Model codex ### Provider / routing chain openclaw -> codex ### Additional provider/model setup details _No response_ ### Logs ```shell ``` ### Screenshots, recordings, and evidence ### Impact and severity Affected: all users who use webapp dashboard Severity: affected user experience and annoying Frequency: always Consequence: Affects UX and increases time to see each card ### Additional information If you add a filter in the workboard by workboard name as well, it would be great. An agent can have multiple workboards.
